title: #071. Single-Machine Weighted Tardiness with Release Dates
subtitle: Schedule jobs on one machine using disjunctive Big-M precedence binaries to minimize total weighted tardiness.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { starts, totalWeightedTardiness }.
